# Greedy: repeatedly pick vertex with smallest degree, add to IS, remove it and its neighbors
vertices = set(range(n))
is_set = set()
while vertices:
    # pick vertex with smallest degree in the remaining graph
    v = min(vertices, key=lambda x: len(adj[x] & vertices))
    is_set.add(v)
    # remove v and its neighbors
    to_remove = {v} | (adj[v] & vertices)
    vertices -= to_remove

print("Greedy IS size:", len(is_set))
print("IS:", sorted(is_set))

# Let's also try a different ordering
best_is = set()
for _ in range(100):
    import random
    vertices = set(range(n))
    is_set = set()
    while vertices:
        # pick random vertex from those with smallest degree
        min_deg = min(len(adj[x] & vertices) for x in vertices)
        candidates = [x for x in vertices if len(adj[x] & vertices) == min_deg]
        v = random.choice(candidates)
        is_set.add(v)
        to_remove = {v} | (adj[v] & vertices)
        vertices -= to_remove
